capabilities: Draws Gantt bars from due date to done date
Groups recurring tasks into summary rows
Filters tasks by date range and count
Derives state from done, due and cancel markers
Refreshes the note when the task file changes
extras: Makes no network requests, collects no telemetry, and only reads the task file named in the code block. The 'Group similar' name-merging feature is beta and off by default.
problem: Obsidian shows tasks as plain lists, with no way to see how long tasks stayed open, what slipped, or how recurring habits accumulate over time.

relations.evidence: Taskscape can visualize the tasks Clockwork Tasks creates
reads lines in the emoji task format used by the Tasks plugin

summary: Code-block renderer that turns Markdown task lists into interactive Gantt timelines or grouped summaries.
